_README: Hand-pinned Google Places matches. step2_fetch_ratings.py looks these up by
id via the Place Details API instead of searching by name, so the match is
deterministic and cannot drift to another business.
A null place_id means the restaurant has no Google listing of its own and

Lodi.note: Ignacio Mattos all-day Italian at Rockefeller Center. Its own listing exists and is flagged CLOSED_PERMANENTLY, so pinning it lets the closure derive correctly instead of the row matching OLIO E PIU.

Maialino Vicino.note: No standalone listing; the name search matched a related but different Maialino entity. Closure asserted separately in research_input/italian/closures_verified.json.
